title: OpenAI introduces new ‘Trusted Contact’ safeguard for cases of possible self-harm

title: Peter Sarlin’s QuTwo reaches $380M valuation in angel round
description: QyTw0, the Finnish AI lab founded by former AMD Silo AI CEO Peter Sarlin, is now valued at €325 million (approximately $380 million) after raising a €25 million angel round ($29 million). It's a sign of enduring tailwinds for AI, quantum computing, and sovereign tech, especially for Europe-made companies.

author: Anna Heim
